title: Many languages. The same understanding.
languages: Tamil · Telugu · Bengali · Kannada · Malayalam · Gujarati · Punjabi · Odia · Urdu
outcome: Nine short appointment enquiries. The AI replies in the customer's language.

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.translation: Hello, is there a slot available tomorrow?

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.text: வணக்கம்! உங்களுக்கு காலை நேரம் வசதியா, மாலை நேரம் வசதியா?
lines.translation: Hello! Would morning or evening work better for you?

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.translation: Hello, can I get an appointment tomorrow?

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.text: తప్పకుండా! మీకు ఉదయం కావాలా, సాయంత్రం కావాలా?
lines.translation: Of course! Would you prefer morning or evening?

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.text: নমস্কার, কাল কি সময় পাওয়া যাবে?
lines.translation: Hello, is there any availability tomorrow?

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.text: নিশ্চয়ই! আপনার সকালে সুবিধা হবে, না বিকেলে?
lines.translation: Certainly! Would morning or afternoon suit you?

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.translation: Hello, is an appointment available tomorrow?

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.text: ಖಂಡಿತ! ನಿಮಗೆ ಬೆಳಿಗ್ಗೆ ಅನುಕೂಲವೇ, ಸಂಜೆ ಅನುಕೂಲವೇ?
lines.translation: Certainly! Is morning or evening convenient for you?

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.translation: Hello, is there a slot tomorrow?

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.translation: Of course! Would morning or evening be convenient?

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.translation: Hello, can I get an appointment tomorrow?

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.text: ચોક્કસ! તમને સવારે ફાવશે કે સાંજે?
lines.translation: Certainly! Would morning or evening suit you?

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.text: ਸਤ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਅਕਾਲ, ਕੱਲ੍ਹ ਲਈ ਸਮਾਂ ਮਿਲ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ?
lines.translation: Hello, can I get a time for tomorrow?

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.text: ਜੀ ਬਿਲਕੁਲ! ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਸਵੇਰੇ ਠੀਕ ਰਹੇਗਾ ਜਾਂ ਸ਼ਾਮ ਨੂੰ?
lines.translation: Yes, of course! Would morning or evening work for you?

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.text: ନମସ୍କାର, କାଲି ପାଇଁ ସମୟ ମିଳିପାରିବ କି?
lines.translation: Hello, could I get a slot for tomorrow?

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.text: ନିଶ୍ଚୟ! ଆପଣଙ୍କୁ ସକାଳେ ସୁବିଧା ହେବ ନା ସନ୍ଧ୍ୟାରେ?
lines.translation: Certainly! Would morning or evening be convenient?

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.text: السلام علیکم، کیا کل کے لیے وقت مل سکتا ہے؟
lines.translation: Hello, could I get an appointment for tomorrow?

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.text: وعلیکم السلام! آپ کو صبح مناسب رہے گی یا شام؟
lines.translation: Hello! Would morning or evening suit you?
